speaker: caller
text: Hi, yeah, I'm calling because I want a refund for my last coffee bag. I didn't like the flavor at all.

speaker: agent
text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you please give me the email address on your account so I can verify it?

speaker: agent
text: Thanks, Bernard, I found your account. Could you tell me the date and amount of your last charge?

speaker: caller
text: It was a $25 charge on September 20th.

speaker: agent
text: I'm sorry, Bernard, but I can't refund that charge. Refunds only cover charges from the last 14 days, and September 20th was 20 days ago. Is there anything else I can help with?

speaker: caller
text: Come on, it's only a few weeks. I didn't even like the coffee. Can't you make an exception?

speaker: agent
text: I understand, and I'm sorry, but I can't make an exception to the 14-day limit. Is there anything else I can help you with, like changing your plan or pausing deliveries?

text:
